messages:
Priya (security-docs): putting up a small docs PR to tighten SOC2 language around audit-log retention, legal holds, and exports. Also adding a concrete SDK snippet for redaction on exports. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6921

Ana (Docs): thanks — can you summarise the behavioral changes? want to avoid language that implies new SLAs.

Priya (security-docs): no SLA changes. Intent: clarify that default audit-log TTL = 90 days; extended retention is available only via contract or an authorized request; legal holds override TTL and are persisted until removed. Also added an example showing how to request an export with redaction and how to set a legal_hold flag via the API/SDK.

Ravi (eng): snippet ready. Minimal JS + curl examples (customers use both hosted and private):
```js
// JS SDK example: create export with redaction and legal hold
const client = new RedwoodClient(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY)
const res = await client.exports.create({
  tenant_id: 'tenant_abc',
  start_time: '2024-09-01T00:00:00Z',
  end_time: '2024-09-30T23:59:59Z',
  redact_fields: ['user_email','ssn'],
  apply_legal_hold: true
})
console.log('export queued', res.id)
```

```bash
# curl example for exports + redaction
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_abc","start_time":"2024-09-01T00:00:00Z","end_time":"2024-09-30T23:59:59Z","redact_fields":["user_email","ssn"],"apply_legal_hold":true}'
```

docs-bot: link-checker flagged /compliance/audit -> should be /security/compliance/retention. Also found stray reference to 'we will' in the section.

Liam (Legal): good. Two edits: 1) replace 'we will retain' with 'Redwood retains' or 'Default retention is'; 2) add a short enumerated list of authorized requesters (account owner, designated legal contact, authorized compliance admins) and note that contractual terms supersede docs where applicable. Avoid operational promises.

Ana (Docs): I'll make those copy edits, swap the link, and add an "How it works" bullet that mentions TTL job runs hourly and legal_hold/durable flags are honored immediately. Keep it short.

Priya (security-docs): perfect. After you push, @Liam can sign off and I'll merge. Also adding a tiny FAQ line: "How to request retention >90 days?" -> contact your account team or include in contract.

Ravi (eng): FYI: for private deployments, our export pipeline redaction is not automatic unless the customer opts into managed exports; added a note to that effect.

Liam (Legal): once Ana updates, ping me. No blockers from legal for wording changes only.

Ana (Docs): updating now — will push an update to PR in ~30m and ping for final review. :rocket:
